answer: An identity may hold only one sample-return lease: a vault sited at a surveyed tidal inlet. A claim is paid only if it encloses an onyx vial whose custody seal binds the inlet coordinates, a continuous temperature log from collection through assay, and a one-time nonce drawn by a random peer. Vials that share a temperature spine or the same coordinates are collapsed into a single lease and the extra stake is slashed, so extra names at one inlet cannot multiply that epoch's payout.
